item.title: Correction · Arden: Arden's completion milestone said June 2016; its cited source, Kinoko Real Estate's Arden page, says only 'Completed in 2016', so it now reads 2016 and cites that page instead of a bare domain. A 2014 milestone saying Arden was under construction, sold out and targeting fall 2015 was removed: it cited only the bare domain livabl.com, no page could be found or read, and nothing else read confirms it. The map notes also flag that the 267-unit figure is not stated by either cited source.
item.description: Arden's completion milestone said June 2016; its cited source, Kinoko Real Estate's Arden page, says only 'Completed in 2016', so it now reads 2016 and cites that page instead of a bare domain. A 2014 milestone saying Arden was under construction, sold out and targeting fall 2015 was removed: it cited only the bare domain livabl.com, no page could be found or read, and nothing else read confirms it. The map notes also flag that the 267-unit figure is not stated by either cited source. Source: Kinoko Real Estate, Arden (https://kinokorealestate.com/developments/arden).

item.title: Complete · Arden: Completed: the Assessor's 2022 roll gives 2016 as year built for the building's unit parcels at 708 and 718 Long Bridge; a sales-agent page says 'Completed in 2016 by Bosa Development'. An architecture database says 'constructed 2014' and Bosa's own page puts its three Mission Bay buildings under 'Active 2005 - 2015', so the year is not firm (~2016)
